note: The three figures of the impossible triangle for the homage site at the start of the first world (scripts/figure_three.py; docs/worlds/rocket/homage.js). Model axes x, y, z up, in cells of the lattice. Each: eye, towards where it closes from; up, the drawing's up (with eye, its right); look, the slope in degrees it is looked at along on the site (positive: looked down on, from a step; negative: looked up at, hung in a gate; about 0: level, on a plinth); said, what the site says of it from its stone. one: the first, as boxes [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1], each face's tone by its axis (x grey, y black, z white). three: the third, a mesh: v positions x1000, w each vertex's tone weights (grey, black, white) x255, t triangles. two: the second, the third study of the figure (the figure and Bent: its beams bowed along the line of sight), a mesh as three.

one.name: The first figure
one.said: Six bars whose ends meet only down the diagonal: it closes from above, as the site draws its buildings.

two.name: The second figure
two.said: The same nine beams, every point moved along the line of sight by a bow across the drawing: from this stone they are straight and it is the drawing; a step aside and they curve away. The third study of the figure, after the figure and Bent.

three.name: The third figure
three.said: The same six bars made one closed thing by a curve: each cut brought together, every bar bowed into a rib of a vault. It closes from below, as you look up at a building.
